sql: SELECT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) AS family, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='resting' AND created_at < now() - interval '4 hours') AS stuck_past_timeout, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='resting') AS resting_now, max(round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-created_at))/60)) FILTER (WHERE status='resting') AS oldest_resting_min, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cancel_reason='timeout' AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS cancelled_ok_24h FROM live_orders WHERE status='resting' OR (cancel_reason='timeout' AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 5 DESC
